name: Ronald Machtley
summary: Ronald Keith Machtley (born July 13, 1948) is an American politician and former president of Bryant University.  Machtley served three terms as a Republican member of the United States House of Representatives from Rhode Island from 1989 to 1995. From 1996 to 2020, Machtley served as president of Bryant University in Smithfield, Rhode Island, and was awarded faculty membership in Omicron Delta Kappa there in 2005.
